messages:
harper (People Ops): Quick note — were granting a short extension window for a small set of review submissions that require documentation for audit (medical notes, LOA approvals). Please follow the triage steps below and RT if you own any rows.

michael (HRBP): How long is the extension window and who qualifies?

harper (People Ops): Window = 72 hours from original deadline. Qualified = documented LOA, medical emergency, or officially approved schedule change. No informal requests.

dina (Eng Manager): I have one report with a submitted self-review but missing LOA doc. Should I attach it to the tracker or send to People Ops?

harper (People Ops): Attach to the secure intake (SFTP link in the tracker) and put the filename in the "audit_evidence" column. If docs are sensitive, use the secure upload form: https://secure.redwood.com/po-upload.

samir (Recruiting Ops): Heads-up: if extensions move comp or hiring decisions into next week, ping recruiting. We may need to pause offer finalization.

harper (People Ops): Triage checklist (copy into comments when you submit):
1) confirm eligibility (LOA/medical/approved schedule)
2) add evidence filename in tracker
3) manager checks approval box + reason
4) add "extension-granted" tag in the row

harper (People Ops): For automation transparency, here's the export we run after triage:
```
curl -s "https://internal-api.redwood/hr/reviews?cycle=FY2026-Q1&filter=extension-granted" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PO_KEY" -o extension_batch.json
python ops/validate_audit.py extension_batch.json --check-files
```

audit-bot: Evidence check: 2 rows missing files -> flagged (auto)

dina (Eng Manager): Thanks — I added the LOA file and tagged the row. Marked approval.

michael (HRBP): If a manager forgets to tag "extension-granted" but evidence exists, will People Ops catch it?

harper (People Ops): We'll run a reconciler. If evidence present but no tag, we'll add it and notify the manager to confirm. If manager doesn't confirm within 48h, escalate to their manager + HRBP.

samir (Recruiting Ops): Noted — please flag any rows that will shift offer timelines.

harper (People Ops): Final: import window closes Fri 5pm PT. After that we can't take changes without exec approval. If you need help, book a 10-min slot: https://calendly.redwood.com/people-ops/10. Will post import summary here when done. :white_check_mark:
